verdict.rationale: Highnote documents API-issued virtual cards with spend rules on MCC, dollar amount and authorization count, plus per-transaction caps evaluated at authorization. Its agentic-commerce page also says cards close automatically when a workflow ends. Together these approximate scoped, short-lived cards, but there is no explicit single-use card type, merchant lock or exact-amount control. missing for 10: an explicit single-use/burner card feature, locking to a specific merchant (not just MCC), exact-amount matching rather than caps, auto-invalidation after first use, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
